about.title: About Mom Recommends
about.privacyText: No account, no tracking, no backend. Your location, preferences and weather stay in this browser.
about.dataTitle: Where does the data come from?
about.dataText: Weather and air quality by Open-Meteo.com. Place names by OpenStreetMap (Nominatim).
about.contactText: During development we answer through the project's GitHub Issues.
about.credits: Made for parents and kids who would rather see the answer than read a number.
